data.body: PASS 1 (G6 approach soundness) review of the remediation epic plan. One finding: the CI-flake bucket delegates to child fade-ea90-7564-4715, whose planned mechanism (app-owned ThreadPoolExecutor disposed via shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True)) encodes a root-cause hypothesis that was later FALSIFIED — the real defect is a Python 3.11 asyncio.wait_for cancellation-consumption race (CPython issue 86296), fixed by commit 8c9bf5d78d (adopting `async with asyncio.timeout(...)`, now present at src/rebar/opcert_service/app.py:136) under duplicate ticket 2207-2917-e21b-42bd. The structural/graph/typing buckets are sound and well-aligned (load_indexed_states, bfs skeleton, and event_commit_git._git_add already exist in the tree exactly as the plan describes). Detailed finding delivered via the review harness.
